decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is a core engineered product of this specialized heat exchanger firm, it launched only recently, and such products have long sales cycles that justify keeping it.
The single-tube air cooled condenser builds on the firm's established finned-tube competence and serves power and process plants, where sales take time to develop.
This second air cooled condenser variant overlaps with Product B, but variants cost little to maintain, so the firm would likely keep it for now.
Liners for corroded tubes are a low-cost aftermarket repair product with steady demand from plant maintenance, and they fit the firm's service business.
Customized industrial air coolers are built to order, so the offering ties up few resources and matches typical German Mittelstand project business.
Tube end repair inserts complement the liners in the aftermarket portfolio and are cheap to keep on offer.
